answer: In PoA, each identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while signature, timing, and funding correlations link coordinated actors. For k identities that equivocate together, penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), so loss exceeds linear exposure. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss and asymmetric depreciation of remaining stake make swarm control prohibitive: a ripple of collusion cannot shelter behind a wharf or glacier of aliases.
